objects.description: [Lucifer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0532) can exploit multiple vulnerabilities including EternalBlue (CVE-2017-0144) and EternalRomance (CVE-2017-0144).(Citation: Unit 42 Lucifer June 2020)
objects.description_fa: [Lucifer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0532) می‌تواند از چندین آسیب‌پذیری از جمله EternalBlue (CVE-2017-0144) و EternalRomance (CVE-2017-0144) سوء استفاده کند.[[CTI_PRESERVE_0]] (Citation: Unit 42 Lucifer June 2020)
